verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing says you can "Run your application closer to where your users are," so the product claims some geographic placement of workloads. That single line does not establish a global edge network, nor say which regions exist or how traffic reaches users. missing for 10: documentation of available regions or edge locations, multi-region or edge deployment mechanics, latency or routing details (e.g., anycast or geo-routing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my code on a global edge network close to end users

citations.quote: Run your application closer to where your users are.
